title: CmdPal: ListItemViewModel.AccessibleName is not used
summary: ListItemViewModel computes and updates AccessibleName as Title plus Subtitle, but the list and grid templates bind AutomationProperties.Name directly to Title.

status.label: Design ready - needs approval
status.detail: Use the maintained AccessibleName property in every list/grid item accessibility template.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current source confirms the property is maintained but bypassed by the templates; no linked implementation is present.

proposed_fixes.title: Bind interactive CmdPal items to AccessibleName
proposed_fixes.root_cause: ListItemViewModel updates the derived AccessibleName property for title and subtitle changes, but the four interactive list/grid templates bind AutomationProperties.Name directly to Title.
plan: Change AutomationProperties.Name to bind to AccessibleName with OneWay updates in ListItemSingleRowViewModelTemplate, SmallGridItemViewModelTemplate, MediumGridItemViewModelTemplate, and GalleryGridItemViewModelTemplate in src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/ExtViews/ListItemsView.xaml.
Keep AutomationProperties.AutomationId bound to Command.Id and leave section/separator templates unchanged.

Retain ListItemViewModel.UpdateAccessibleName in src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels/ListItemViewModel.cs and add or update tests for initial and live title/subtitle accessibility-name updates.
verification: Build CmdPal UI and existing unit/UI tests.
Inspect an interactive item with an accessibility inspector in list, small-grid, medium-grid, and gallery layouts.
Change an item's title or subtitle and verify the automation name updates without changing its automation id.

confidence.rationale: The maintained property and all four Title bindings are directly confirmed in source; the remaining uncertainty is limited to empty-subtitle formatting and consumers of exact automation text.

judgment.rationale: The source directly confirms both halves of the report: AccessibleName is updated in the view model and Title is bound in all item templates.
evidence: Observed: ListItemViewModel.UpdateAccessibleName sets AccessibleName to Title plus Subtitle and raises a property update.
Observed: ListItemsView.xaml binds AutomationProperties.Name to Title in the single-row, small-grid, medium-grid, and gallery templates.
Observed: the issue asks whether the maintained property should be used; it is labeled Issue-Bug but has no linked fix.
Inferred: screen readers lose subtitle context in item names, especially where title alone is ambiguous.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused XAML binding change and add a view-model/template accessibility regression test.

issue_context.summary: CmdPal spends CPU updating AccessibleName but templates do not consume it.
known_information: ListItemViewModel computes AccessibleName from Title and Subtitle.
ListItemsView.xaml binds AutomationProperties.Name to Title in four visual item templates.
inferences: The intended accessible name likely includes subtitle context.
Section and separator templates should remain noninteractive and need not consume AccessibleName.
issue_context.analysis: This is a narrow accessibility wiring defect rather than a request to change the view-model computation. The safest correction is to consume the already-maintained property wherever an interactive list/grid item exposes an automation name.

design.root_cause: The view model's derived AccessibleName property is updated for title/subtitle changes, but the four interactive item templates bind AutomationProperties.Name directly to Title, making the derived property dead for accessibility.
evidence: src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels/ListItemViewModel.cs: UpdateAccessibleName updates AccessibleName whenever Title or Subtitle changes.
src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/ExtViews/ListItemsView.xaml: item templates use x:Bind Title for AutomationProperties.Name.

implementation_steps.change: Bind AutomationProperties.Name to AccessibleName with the same OneWay update behavior in all four interactive templates.
edge_cases: Do not change AutomationProperties.AutomationId, which remains Command.Id.
Preserve empty subtitle formatting as produced by the existing view-model.
tests: Add or update a CmdPal UI accessibility test to assert title plus subtitle for list and grid presentations.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The property updates on initial load and title/subtitle changes.
implementation_steps.change: Keep the existing computation unless tests show empty-value formatting is undesirable; do not duplicate the concatenation in XAML.
edge_cases: Ensure live title/subtitle changes continue to raise AccessibleName property notification.
tests: View-model test for initial and changed title/subtitle values.

verify: Build CmdPal UI and existing unit/UI tests.
Inspect an interactive item with an accessibility inspector in list, small-grid, medium-grid, and gallery layouts.
Change an item's title or subtitle and verify the automation name updates without changing its automation id.
risks: Automation text changes may affect brittle UI tests or screen-reader snapshots.
The current comma formatting may expose a trailing comma for empty subtitles.
alternatives: Remove AccessibleName and compute in XAML. Rejected because it duplicates logic and loses the existing update seam.
Bind only the list template. Rejected because grid presentations would remain inaccessible/inconsistent.

notes: Confirm exact empty-subtitle formatting with existing UI expectations.
